description:
A CWL 1.2 workflow that runs a deterministic synthetic peptide sequence, unit-safe reconstitution calculation and positive-mode LC-MS calculation with a provenance summary. The fixture contains no customer, clinical, batch, instrument or experimental data.A single-step CWL workflow for a public synthetic example. The input and
output are JSON files so the run can be archived, compared and cited without
an instrument or private sample data.
name: repro-lab-kit CWL workflow
